source_evidence:
Exact player 'Yes let’s have one more night in n Orsaven, then head out for the ruins' authorizes return to Copper Hart and one ordinary city overnight at existing 2gp package, then the chosen western service-house expedition. D328 afternoon/evening party leaves Desen and Sornell to their independent lawful investigation, returns to inn, ordinary dinner/stabling/rooms paid once: 2039gp8sp6cp→2037gp8sp6cp; no carried provision charge. Standing pre-SR Psi Recovery used before planned rest: Psi4→5, feature1→0; full HP no Second Wind. Peaceful qualifying city overnight completes weighted LR4+2=6/6 at D329~07:30, resets new cycle0/6. Restore V Psi5→6/6, Sup3→4/4, PastLife1→3/3, freeWhispers0→1/1, PsiRecovery0→1/1; all other V pools and HD already full. Cirren and Fenar all pools/HD already full, retain existing Fenar CLIMB40 adaptation. No extra healing or double counted night.

Day329 dawn routine Tamsin Sending Stones contact, no specific new estate result. Actual pending paid Tavosk single-notice availability d20 face15 under previously declared1–15 no notice/16–20 receive; no notice arrived, no new payment. No new royal instruction or Desen outcome communicated; no daily Crown reroll. V authorized journey to previously identified western Ossent outlying service-house crossing (not later lost seat): Mara's authenticated survey48mi ordinary road WNW plus12 rough hill track (~3days each way). Party and coach/four horses depart Copper Hart after ordinary preparations; inn can retain addressed correspondence, no separate charge or new letter/dispatch implied. Route leg3days, cap floor(.7×3)=2 random encounter days, ordinary road DAY1–15/NIGHT1–7; exposed roadside camps, no assumed secured lodging. Local creature eligible list predeclared wolves/giant boar/owlbear; no monster result. D329 daytime37 quiet, day travel24mi, actual food/feed charge3/4→18 rations/24 feed; exposed night35 quiet, qualifying wilderness SR and LR0→1 at D330 dawn; no resource expenditure/extra refresh. Routine Tamsin contact D330, no specific new estate transaction. D330 daytime28 quiet, second24mi completed, total48 road miles. Day food/feed3/4→15 rations/20 feed. Camp beside road near final rough-track junction; actual coach staging/access choice still pending; no rough-track entry or crossing reached. No paid lodging, extra purchase, unchosen diversion, new royal decision or Watch outcome.

D330~21:00, exposed roadside camp at end of second road day before sleeping. Actual night occurrence5 (≤7), type53 (43–59 dangerous humanoid group), hostile severity42 (31–75 serious). New finite local incident: six armed abductors transporting two restrained adult captives for ransom, independent local group, no established connection to Harthvale, Quenwood, political conspiracy or ancestry. Fixed encounter roster before combat: one MM2014 Veteran, three Scouts, two Thugs; two ordinary adult captives (Commoners; both alive; one struggling from fatigue, no HP damage asserted). 1200 base/2400 adjusted XP with all six hostiles, three actual combat PCs; no encounter auto-level or reward. One man carries torch, others visibly armed; they are already acting coercively toward captives, not yet attacking V. Camp at (0,0), coach and tethered four horses and Mara near (0,-10), V/Cirren/Fenar near campfire before bed, exact personal combat squares to be established on declared actions. Road east-west at y=70, group centered around (40,70) roughly80ft from camp; six abductors and two captives loosely grouped within30ft along road, walking west toward track junction; torch bright20/dim20; campfire ordinary light; intervening low hawthorn and ditch provide partial visual screening, not automatic concealment/full cover. Voices audible, visible torch and silhouettes, one captive calls 'Please! He can't go any farther!' one guard hauls the stumbling other upright. Fenar alerts companions; no new V action or speech, no assumed surprise, attack, initiative, hostile detection of camp or guaranteed hidden party. V can approach/intervene/observe/avoid; choose next action. Actual current D330 night encounter consumes one of2 allowed random encounter days on this3-day leg; no D330 overnight completed, LR1/6 not yet reset by damage/expenditure. No roll beyond listed receipts; no arrival or forced new quest.
pending_action: Day330~21:00 exposed camp near western Ossent final rough-track junction, 48/60 planned route miles traveled from Orsaven, 12 rough hill miles remain (~one day subject to coach suitability/staging). Armed group on road ~80ft away, six finite hostile abductors (DM-only roster Veteran,3 Scouts,2 Thugs using MM2014; no combat/initiative yet), two living restrained adult captives; one calls for help for struggling companion. Torch/road/low hawthorn/ditch as in event; V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar near camp, coach/4 horses healthy. No attack or confirmed group knowledge of party, V next decision pending. D329 quiet day/night rolls37/35; D330 quiet day28, night5/type53/severity42 serious, 1/2 encounter days, no night roll again, no rest yet. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 inactive cloak+Luckstone attuned; dice delegated until stopped. Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots/+1Shield no concentration. Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia. Mara healthy. Purse2037gp8sp6cp, rations15/feed20, LR1/6. D328→329 qualifying full city LR completed once, D329→330 quiet wilderness night completed once, D330 full day provisions charged once; current night pending. D329 Tavosk15 no notice; royal proposal considered but undecided, no new received Desen result. Desen holds original36gp Lot27 invoice and14gp Tavosk acknowledgement, copy of notes, copies of Sallow referral and Tavosk receipt; V retains notes, new originals, invitation and Harthvale nonbinding memorandum; Cirren signed evidence receipt. Sornell cooperates, safety/records/enforcement not confirmed. Harthvale deal unaccepted, no250gp paid; Halvessa conditional250gp exclusive offer unpaid/unaccepted. Paymaster48gp held restitution, none distributed; Quenwood life sentence upheld/assets frozen. Western conditional recovery grant not deed; preserve ferrier/public rights and verify parcel/hazards. Mara authenticated survey and notes, V grant instrument. Coris300 documentary assessment pending and optional800 field unearned; Crown commission300+1300 contingent; commissions520 due actual completion target353; Kestrel custody/copies, Elara Caereth and Severin assent unconfirmed unchanged. No new quest reward, travel hazard damage, arrival, rest, or expenditure beyond actual recorded inn/provisions.
